cohort: Patients who underwent caesarean section in a hospital in central India over a six-month period.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 57.80%, with the highest rates in Robson's group 5 (multiparous with prior caesarean section, singleton, cephalic, >=37 weeks) and group 2 (nulliparous, singleton, cephalic, >=37 weeks, induced labor or caesarean section before labor).
